_comment: Dynamic priority configuration for the email-triage agent. Edit this file anytime to add/remove VIP senders or keywords — no code changes needed. The agent reads this on every run.

buckets.name: Needs Response
buckets.description: Direct questions, explicit asks, deadlines, or anything requiring you to reply.

buckets.name: Important - Read Only
buckets.description: From VIP senders, or financial/legal/medical/HR content that should be read but may not need a reply.

buckets.name: FYI / Low Priority
buckets.description: Newsletters, automated notifications, cc-only threads, digests.

notes: vip_senders: add email addresses (e.g. "boss@company.com") - any mail from these always ranks into 'Important - Read Only' or higher regardless of keyword match.
To add a new bucket, append an object to 'buckets' with a unique 'rank' (lower = higher priority) and a 'keywords' list.
You can ask the agent directly: 'add vip sender x@y.com' or 'add keyword contract renewal to Needs Response' and it will update this file.

This setup reads mail via local Outlook COM automation (outlook-mcp-readonly), not Microsoft Graph. There is no server-side classifier here - all bucket matching happens in the agent's own reasoning against this file.
